Tabulate Class-Level Testing Support, by Group

Source: R/profile_eligibility.R
profile_audit_support.Rd

Pure counting – no statistics. For every group (hospital, district, whatever group_col holds) and every class in class_cols, counts how many events were tested, how many were resistant, and how many were susceptible. Also produces the same counts for every class pair (co-tested) and for the full class set at once (complete panel), since a hospital can have plenty of events yet too few co-tested pairs or complete panels for a joint model.

Usage

profile_audit_support(
  data,
  group_col,
  class_cols,
  class_col = NULL,
  value_col = "antibiotic_value",
  resistant_values = c("R", "Resistant", "resistant"),
  susceptible_values = c("S", "Susceptible", "susceptible"),
  intermediate_values = c("I", "Intermediate", "intermediate"),
  intermediate_as_resistant = TRUE,
  event_id_col = NULL,
  unknown_action = c("error", "treat_as_untested"),
  conflict_action = c("error", "drop_conflicts", "resistant_wins", "susceptible_wins",
    "first")
)

Arguments

data

Data frame, one row per event x class (long) or one row per event with one column per class (wide) – auto-detected from whether class_cols resolve to one shared value column or to several distinct columns.

group_col

Character. Column identifying the stratum (hospital, district, lab, ...). Not assumed to mean "hospital".

class_cols

Character vector. Antibiotic classes in the panel. For long data, these are the values class_col takes. For wide data, these are column names, each holding an S/I/R-type result.

class_col

Character. For long-format data, the column naming which class a row's result belongs to. Ignored for wide data (when class_cols resolve to real column names in data).

value_col

Character. Column holding the susceptibility result. Resistant is matched case-insensitively against resistant_values; susceptible against susceptible_values; anything else (including NA) counts as untested for that class.

resistant_values, susceptible_values, intermediate_values

Character vectors of values in value_col counted as resistant / susceptible / intermediate. Defaults cover the common `"R"`/`"S"`/`"I"` and `"Resistant"`/`"Susceptible"`/`"Intermediate"` spellings. Intermediate results still count toward tested regardless of intermediate_as_resistant – an ambiguous result is still a result, not a missing test.

intermediate_as_resistant

Logical. When TRUE (default, matching the clinical convention already used by prep_recode_intermediate_ast() elsewhere in anumaan), intermediate results are folded into resistant for the class-level counts and into the "R" side of the pairwise RR/RS/SR/SS breakdown. When FALSE, intermediate results are reported only in their own intermediate column/count and excluded from the binary resistant/susceptible tallies (class-level) and from the pairwise cell breakdown (they still count toward co_tested, since co-testing is about coverage, not the result).

event_id_col

Character or NULL. If supplied, used to dedupe rows before counting complete-panel support (one row per event x class is assumed otherwise).

unknown_action, conflict_action

Passed through to the shared AST policy in .profile_tested_long_wide: unknown_action (default "error") controls what happens to a non-blank value_col value that matches none of resistant_values/ susceptible_values/intermediate_values; conflict_action (default "error") controls what happens when the same group x event x class cell has duplicate rows with DIFFERING results.

Value

A list with three data frames:

class

one row per group x class: tested, resistant, susceptible, intermediate (the raw intermediate count, always reported regardless of how it was folded into resistant) – kept for backward compatibility – plus the separated AST-policy counts n_raw_tested (every non-blank raw value seen, including unrecognized ones, before dedup), n_binary_observed (= tested, the resolved R/S/I count after dedup/conflict handling), n_R/n_S/ n_I (raw per-category counts, before intermediate_as_resistant folding), n_untested (genuinely blank/NA/declared untested-token rows), n_invalid (non-blank, unrecognized values – only nonzero when unknown_action = "treat_as_untested"; otherwise such a value stops the function), and n_duplicates_collapsed (identical-result duplicate rows collapsed to one)

pair

one row per group x unordered class pair: co_tested (both classes have any result, R/I/S), and the n_RR/n_RS/n_SR/n_SS 2x2 breakdown plus near_separation (TRUE when any one of those four cells is below 5, the same historical near-separation rule used for the J2-L hospital tiers)

profile

one row per group: complete_panel, the count of events with every class in class_cols tested
